content.comment_body: I have a [article_no] [product_name] module but I am unable to establish communication with my Weintek screen. Everything is programmed and set up, and I am using EasyBuilder Pro (latest version) for HMI programming. The IP settings are correct, the ethernet cable is working, and I have tested with four new [product_name] devices, so I don't think the hardware is faulty. Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated!

I'm unsure exactly how you want the [product_name] to communicate with the Weintek HMI. The [article_no] [product_name] is the latest [version_no]. It supports Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 protocol or Modbus TCP/IP. You need to enable access for these protocols in the device's configuration settings.
Are you familiar with this Youtube video?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing consistent issues establishing communication between a [product_name] module and a Weintek HMI, even with correct network and hardware configuration and current HMI programming tools. Forum responses clarify that enabling the correct communication protocol (such as S7 or Modbus TCP/IP) in the [product_name] setup is necessary—an important troubleshooting step that may not be immediately apparent. The discussion highlights that selecting and configuring protocols is a major challenge when integrating [company_name] hardware with third-party HMI devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates straightforward integration of their [company_name] [product_name] module with a Weintek HMI over standard Ethernet protocols, expecting minimal configuration requirements and clear protocol compatibility.
